note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; language tags are labels only and imply no jurisdiction. No preset states an outcome, validity or preference between A and B.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: Same letter, segments, guides and people; only the equivalent of «lonja» differs (written in A, kept as «lonja» with a question mark in B).

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: a four-segment visit notice where the examined term is in the first segment («hórreo»); still exactly one changed fact.

clauses: El grupo se reúne junto al hórreo de la finca.
La visita empieza a las diez.
Se ruega llegar con calzado cómodo.
La salida es por la puerta norte.
translations: The group meets beside the farm granary.
The exit is through the north gate.

scenarioB.label: Equivalence not confirmed
scenarioB.caption: «hórreo» is kept in the translation with a query

params.changedFact: The only difference: how «hórreo» appears in segment 1

comparisonLabels.neutral: Shown for comparison only — no effect is stated

presets.name: long-labels-stress
presets.description: Long scenario labels, captions, segments and notes.

params.documentTitle: Carta de coordinación para la entrega y recepción de mercancías en el puerto
params.targetTitle: Coordination letter for the delivery and receipt of goods at the harbour
clauses: El proveedor entrega veinte cajas de material de laboratorio el día 3 por la mañana.
La carga se deja en la lonja del puerto, junto a la báscula municipal.
Cada parte guarda una copia firmada de esta carta en su propio archivo.
translations: The supplier delivers twenty boxes of laboratory material on the morning of day 3.
The load is left at the port fish-market hall, next to the municipal scale.
Each party keeps a signed copy of this letter in its own archive.
